name: w3c-validator-plus
displayName: Web Standards Validator for HTML & JSP
description: Validate HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and JSP locally. HTML and CSS checks are powered by the Nu Html Checker (the engine behind validator.w3.org/nu).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces only the built-in engines run. Workspace values for the Java path and validator server URL are ignored, and custom rule code is never loaded.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Validation runs on the editor text, so virtual files are supported.

enumDescriptions: Validate when a file is opened or saved.
Validate while typing (debounced). The HTML engine still only runs on save unless `webValidator.vnu.validateOnType` is enabled.
Validate only when a command is run.

webValidator.onTypeDelayMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds when `webValidator.run` is `onType`.

webValidator.maxFileSizeKb.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are not validated.

webValidator.java.home.markdownDescription: Path to a Java 11+ installation (JDK/JRE home folder or the `java` executable). When empty, `JAVA_HOME`, `PATH` and the JRE bundled with the Red Hat Java extension are tried in that order.

enumDescriptions: Run the bundled Nu Html Checker locally (requires Java). Nothing leaves your machine.
Send documents to the Nu Html Checker HTTP server at `webValidator.vnu.serverUrl`.
webValidator.vnu.mode.description: How to run the Nu Html Checker.

webValidator.vnu.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of a self-hosted Nu Html Checker server, e.g. `http://localhost:8888/`. Used only when `webValidator.vnu.mode` is `server`. Document contents are sent to this URL.

webValidator.vnu.validateOnType.markdownDescription: Also run the Nu Html Checker while typing when `webValidator.run` is `onType`.

webValidator.vnu.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single Nu Html Checker request, in milliseconds.

enumDescriptions: Skip `<!DOCTYPE>`, `<html>`, `<head>` and `<body>`: every JSP is validated as a fragment. Suits includes, SPA partials loaded into an existing element, and header/footer files that open or close `<body>`.
Validate full pages including their document structure. Files without `<html>` or `<!DOCTYPE>` are still validated as fragments.
webValidator.jsp.documentStructure.markdownDescription: How `<!DOCTYPE>`, `<html>`, `<head>` and `<body>` are handled in JSP files. Everything inside them is validated either way.

webValidator.jsp.customTagPrefixes.markdownDescription: Tag prefixes treated as JSP custom tags (their markup is skipped, their body is validated). `jsp:` and prefixes declared with `<%@ taglib prefix="…" %>` are always included.

webValidator.trace.description: Logging level for the Web Validator output channel.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p test/integration && node out/test/integration/runTest.js
